policy: An entry is permitted only for an intentionally defensive boundary where the exception is logged or the caller receives an explicit degraded/unknown result. Do not use this file to make a readiness gate green without owner review.

entries.reason: Rollback is best effort during a connection-loss poll. The caller records the original transient error, retries the probe, and the connection is discarded if it cannot roll back; no success is returned from this handler.

Custom-role validation degrades to built-in role names when the custom_roles table is absent (pre-migration deployments). The caller then rejects unknown role names with 422, so the degraded result is explicit rather than silent; no custom role is fabricated.

Role-name cleaning degrades to the built-in VALID_ROLES set when the custom_roles table cannot be read (pre-migration or schema drift). Assignment of an unresolvable name then falls back to the viewer default rather than storing an unvalidated role string; the API layer still 422s unknown names first.
